roadmap.title: Start the base game
roadmap.description: Finish your first job and do the quick hammer achievements.

roadmap.title: Sell houses to every buyer
roadmap.description: Sell to each buyer type, then build up sales, negotiation and money.

roadmap.title: Apocalypse buyers
roadmap.description: Sell bunker houses to the three bunker buyers.

roadmap.title: Garden DLC
roadmap.description: Do gardening jobs, contests and planting goals.

roadmap.title: HGTV DLC
roadmap.description: Play the HGTV jobs and the one-off tricks.

roadmap.title: Luxury DLC
roadmap.description: Play Moonrise Bay jobs and finish the one-off tasks.

roadmap.title: Pets DLC
roadmap.description: Adopt pets and try each interaction.

roadmap.title: Farm DLC
roadmap.description: Do farm jobs, animals, crops and drone work.

roadmap.title: Dine Out DLC
roadmap.description: Play the 10 restaurant jobs, cooking, renting and presets.

roadmap.title: Finish up
roadmap.description: Sell 50 houses, finish every house and complete every job at 100%.

achievements.description: Family isn't just an important thing, it's everything.
achievements.summary: Close a sale with the Jonson Family as the buyers.

guide.context: A full kitchen can bring the Smoth couple instead, so avoid one.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Unsatisfying effect}.
Leave the bathrooms, existing bedroom and living area alone.
Buy 4 @item{Single Bed Mantis} and 1 @item{Sofa Rodon}. Put a bed in every room and the hallway for 6 bedrooms in total.
Complete the sale with the @npc{Jonson Family}.

achievements.description: I'm not a genius, but I am smarter than you are.
achievements.summary: Sell a house to Chang Choi.

guide.context: Other buyers may take the house first. Removing the bathroom helps keep them away.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Abandoned house}, remove garbage and clean it.
Remove the walls to make one big room, but keep the bathroom walls. Remove the sink.
Buy a @item{Bed Peony}, @item{Desk Anna}, a @item{B-shape chair}, 2 @item{Cabinet with hanging shelves} and 3 bunny toys.
Sell to @npc{Chang Choi}.

achievements.description: Mind over matter. Money over all.
achievements.summary: Sell a house to Dolan Trusk.

steps.text: Buy @loc{House that is hiding something}.
Do not clean it and do not add furniture or appliances.
Sell to @npc{Dolan Trusk}.

achievements.description: Fashion is my armor against the realities of everyday life.
achievements.summary: Sell a house to Gorgio Shanua.

guide.context: He does not want a kitchen, so remove it.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Burned house} and clean it.
Remove the kitchen.
Buy 2 @item{Linen closet} and a @item{Double bed Warmy} and place them in the rooms.
Sell to @npc{Gorgio Shanua}.

achievements.description: It's business. Leave your feelings at the door.
achievements.summary: Sell a house to Jack Tarinton.

guide.context: A kitchen sink makes him pass. Do not leave any kitchen sink in the house.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Huckster's House} and sell the kitchen sink.
Furnish the first bathroom with a toilet and a @item{Sink with cabinet PRYZMAT}. Give the second bathroom a toilet.
In the big living area, add 1-2 sofas, a coffee table and a TV.
Sell to @npc{Jack Tarinton}.

achievements.description: Bra off, party on!
achievements.summary: Sell a house to Jimmy Traitor.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Home Admin-Legends}.
Buy a @item{Coffee table Ramvik} and place it in the kitchen area.
Sell to @npc{Jimmy Traitor}.

achievements.description: Age is just a number. Live life fully, no matter how old you are.
achievements.summary: Close a sale with the Jantart Family as the buyers.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Camping bungalow}, remove garbage, clean everything and the windows, and install heaters.
Remove everything in the living room and bedroom. Add carpets to each room.
For the new bedroom, buy @item{Classic chest of drawers}, @item{Double bed Aspelund}, @item{Zantedeschia in a pot} and @item{Picture Autumn Lake}.
Sell to the @npc{Jantart Family}.

achievements.description: Always be prepared for the unknown.
achievements.summary: Sell a house with a bunker to Lonewolf37.

guide.context: Bunker buyers only come to houses that have a bunker.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Garage with bunker}.
Sell it without changes to @npc{Lonewolf37}.

achievements.description: Remember: when disaster strikes, the time to prepare has passed.
achievements.summary: Sell a house with a bunker to Ted Arrown.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Garage with bunker} and do not clean or install anything.
Go down to the bunker and buy 2 @item{Turbine Power Generator} and 2 @item{Bunk Bed}.
Sell to @npc{Ted Arrown}.

achievements.description: Better to prep 10 years too early than 10 minutes too late!
achievements.summary: Sell a house with a bunker to Maria Kolkowsky.

guide.context: Do not keep weapons in the bunker.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Old house with bunker}.
Sell it without changes to @npc{Maria Kolkowsky}, negotiating a little.

achievements.description: What happens in the cave stays in the cave.
achievements.summary: Sell a house to Rafael Erko.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Home Admin-Legends}.
Start the sale without changes and sell to @npc{Rafael Erko}.

achievements.description: You know, when you're in love, you can't get any sleep… because of your kids screaming around the clock!
achievements.summary: Close a sale with the Smoth Family as the buyers.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Family house} or @loc{Just married's house}.
Sell it without changes to the @npc{Smoth Family}.

achievements.description: Every child is an artist. The challenge lies in remaining an artist throughout one's adult life.
achievements.summary: Sell a house to Veronica Liptson.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Variable woman's house}.
Sell the sink in the kitchen.
Buy and hang 7 pictures or paintings.
Sell to @npc{Veronica Liptson}.

achievements.description: Complete first job!
achievements.summary: Finish your first job.

steps.text: Open the laptop and finish the first job.

achievements.description: Earn your first million euro.
achievements.summary: Earn 1,000,000 Euro in total.

guide.context: Set the currency to Euro (Settings > General) so the target matches.

steps.text: Buy @loc{House that is hiding something}.
Head to the basement and smash the left wall beside the junction box.
Sell the armchair, sideboard and valuable painting in the secret room.
Sell the house. Repeat the loop until you reach 1,000,000.

achievements.description: Finish the game.
achievements.summary: Sell every house in the game at least once.

guide.context: Houses from DLC you own also count. Move your office once so you can sell the First Office.

steps.text: Buy and sell each house in the list once.
Move your office to another house so you can sell @loc{First Office}.
Sell any DLC houses you own as well.

achievements.description: Complete a job in less than 1 minute.
achievements.summary: Finish a job in under one minute.

guide.context: Only the job's 70% minimum is needed. Redoing an order this way resets its completion bar, so earn Perfectionist first or redo the order fully afterward.

steps.text: Upgrade your skills first. The Quick Orders perk lowers the minimum by 10%.
Start one of the first two orders and do only the work needed to reach 70%.
For the garage-cleaning order, clean the window first.

achievements.description: Complete every job all the way.
achievements.summary: Finish every job at 100%.

guide.context: Jobs can be replayed. Replay any job that ended below 100%. Do the jobs of every DLC you own too.

steps.text: Open the jobs list on the laptop and replay each job that is below 100% until all show 100%.

achievements.description: I am the one who knocks.
achievements.summary: Knock on the front door of Huckster's House with your hammer.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Huckster's House}, go to its front door, and hit the door with your hammer a few times.

achievements.description: Successfully negotiate a sale earning no less than 50,000 Euro.
achievements.summary: Sell a house and negotiate the price up by at least 50,000 Euro.

guide.context: Set the currency to Euro first (Settings > General). Other currencies change the amount you need.

steps.text: Set the currency to Euro in Settings > General.
Spend skill points on every Price Negotiation perk.
Buy @loc{Alone Home}, clean it inside and out, then start a sale.
Negotiate for 50,000 or more above the offer. If the buyer declines, try a slightly different amount.

achievements.description: Do you even lift?
achievements.summary: Pick up a car.

steps.text: Go to a house with a car, such as @loc{Home and Car}, @loc{Garage with Bunker} or @loc{Pink Kingdom}.
Pick up the car with the lift key.

achievements.description: You'll need a car mechanic.
achievements.summary: Hit a car with your hammer.

steps.text: Go to a house with a car, such as @loc{Home and Car}, @loc{Garage with Bunker} or @loc{Pink Kingdom}, and hit the car with your hammer.

achievements.description: Kill a cockroach with a hammer.
achievements.summary: Kill a cockroach by hitting it with your hammer.

guide.context: Pressing the use key near a cockroach starts the vacuum instead. Stand where no vacuum prompt shows before you swing.

steps.text: Wait in a dirty house until a cockroach appears.
Hold the hammer and swing at it. Do not use the vacuum cleaner.
If the cockroach vanishes, you killed it.

achievements.description: Sell 10 houses.
achievements.summary: Sell 10 houses.

guide.context: Houses can be sold in the state you bought them.

steps.text: Buy a cheap house and sell it right away. Repeat until you have sold 10.
Press Esc during the sale to skip ahead.

achievements.description: Sell 20 houses.
achievements.summary: Sell 20 houses.

steps.text: Keep buying cheap houses and selling them right away until you have sold 20.

achievements.description: Sell 50 houses.
achievements.summary: Sell 50 houses.

guide.context: The sales from Junior and Estate agent count toward this total.

steps.text: Keep buying the cheapest houses and selling them right away until you have sold 50.

achievements.description: Don't forget to take it out of the rain!
achievements.summary: Place your laptop in a garden and use it there.

steps.text: Carry your laptop out to the yard, set it down, and press E on it.

achievements.description: It's time to broaden my qualifications!
achievements.summary: Finish the first Garden DLC job.

steps.text: Open the green mail from Eveline Hawes on the laptop and finish the job.

achievements.description: Look at my garden, it's amazing!
achievements.summary: Enter a garden in the Garden Contest.

steps.text: Open the sell menu with Enter in a house with a garden.
Choose submit garden for contest.

achievements.description: Feel Shi… Fence Shi… Well, I tried.
achievements.summary: Get 5 stars for Layout in the Garden Contest.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Garden after house construction}.
Submit the garden for the contest right away.
Choose the English, American or Modern style.

achievements.description: Blue flower, red thorns…
achievements.summary: Get 5 stars for Plant selection in the Garden Contest.

steps.text: Buy @loc{First office}.
Plant 25 carrots, 25 parsley, 10 pumpkins, 10 zucchini, 10 blueberry, 10 cucumis and 10 raspberry shrubs.
Submit the garden and choose the crop style.

achievements.description: Haven't you forgotten about a place for a few flowers between this sofa and the carousel?
achievements.summary: Get 5 stars for Equipment in the Garden Contest.

steps.text: Buy @loc{Huckster's House} and go into the garden.

Place 1 @item{Sofa Jamaica}, 2 @item{Chair Jamaica}, 1 @item{Table Jamaica}, 2 @item{Couch Beto}, 1 @item{Garden umbrella Nasofa}, 1 @item{Carousel Asobi}, 1 @item{Grill Fury}, 20 @item{Ball Solar lamp}, 1 @item{Alu Arbor} and a @item{Hammock Melod} or @item{Hammock Drelod}.
Submit the garden and choose the American style.

achievements.description: You can't hide from my mover!
achievements.summary: Use the Garden DLC tools to plant seeds, spread gravel and remove weeds.

steps.text: Play the first Garden DLC job and use each new tool, such as planting, spreading gravel and removing weeds.
If nothing unlocks, use the Flamethrower.

achievements.description: I feel this gardener aura inside of me…
achievements.summary: Unlock every Gardener perk.

steps.text: Do Garden jobs and gardening work to earn skill points.
Spend the points on all three Gardener perks: Quick, Equipped and Gardeners Sense.

achievements.description: Tell the meatatarians my last word is… Carrot…
achievements.summary: Plant at least 50 carrots.

guide.context: The count may need to go a little past 50 before it unlocks.

steps.text: Buy carrot seeds and plant carrots in any garden until you pass 50. Keep going up to about 75 if it has not unlocked.

achievements.description: Bath time?
achievements.summary: Fill ponds with water 15 times in total.

guide.context: One pond is enough. Fill it, drain it, and fill it again.

steps.text: Install a pond.
Fill it with water, then drain it. Repeat until you have filled 15 ponds in total.

achievements.description: Your time has come, Mr. Mole…
achievements.summary: Remove the molehills on a Garden DLC map.

steps.text: Go to a Garden DLC map with molehills.
Remove every molehill until the mole appears.

achievements.description: Is this hammer even real?
achievements.summary: Hit a Wooden Fan Pedro with your hammer.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Wooden Fan Pedro} from Garden > Other and place it.
Hit it with your hammer.

achievements.description: Care to do something more with all that's left?
achievements.summary: Spend almost all of the budget in an HGTV job.

steps.text: Start an HGTV job and buy furniture and items until almost none of its budget is left.

achievements.description: Must-have: lots of space.
achievements.summary: Remove all the interior walls of a house.

guide.context: It works in any house you own, not only HGTV houses.

steps.text: Buy @loc{First office}.
Break every interior wall with your hammer, including the bathroom walls.

achievements.description: Must-have: room for family gatherings.
achievements.summary: Furnish a living room for a large family.

steps.text: Make a large living room with a corner sofa, a coffee table, a big table and chairs.
If nothing unlocks, lift the big table and set it down in the HGTV job A new beginning.
Another option is to open up the ground floor of @loc{Alone Home} then place a corner sofa, a TV and a TV cabinet there.

achievements.description: On the other hand…
achievements.summary: Replay an HGTV job and choose the other person at both choices.

guide.context: You only need to pick the options. You do not need to finish the tasks.

steps.text: Finish an HGTV job that has two choices once.
Start the same job again and choose the opposite person at each choice.

achievements.description: Can you hear it?
achievements.summary: Turn on the covered fireplace in the HGTV job Uninvited guests.

steps.text: Start the HGTV job @loc{Uninvited guests}.
Switch on the fireplace so the bats leave the chimney.

achievements.description: Can't have a leak when there are no pipes!
achievements.summary: Sell a leaking radiator pipe instead of repairing it.

steps.text: Start the HGTV job @loc{Only one half}.
Hit a wall that has a radiator pipe behind it until the leak message shows.
Sell the broken pipe with the sell tool. Do not repair it.

achievements.description: Let's do the time warp again!
achievements.summary: Compare a job's before and after pictures in your Portfolio.

guide.context: Finish a job first so it appears in your Portfolio.

steps.text: Open the laptop and choose Portfolio.
Pick a job and a picture, then press Enter to see the comparison.

achievements.description: Now we're talking!
achievements.summary: Choose only Oliver's tasks in an HGTV job that has 3 choices.

guide.context: Water Horizon and Last Moving both have 3 choices.

steps.text: Start @loc{Water Horizon} or @loc{Last Moving}.
At each of the 3 choices, pick @npc{Oliver}.

achievements.description: This place could use a woman's touch!
achievements.summary: Choose only Greta's tasks in an HGTV job that has 3 choices.

guide.context: Water Horizon and Last Moving both have 3 choices.

steps.text: Start @loc{Water Horizon} or @loc{Last Moving}.
At each of the 3 choices, pick @npc{Greta}.

achievements.description: I will not click on the map.
achievements.summary: Click Homer's house on the HGTV map.

guide.context: It has a purple car in front.

steps.text: Open the HGTV map on the laptop.
Click the house with a purple car in front.

achievements.description: Fix them all!
achievements.summary: Finish every job on the HGTV map.

steps.text: Do each HGTV job on the HGTV map until every house is done.

achievements.description: Move your office to a beach house from the HGTV DLC.
achievements.summary: Move your office to a beach house from the HGTV DLC.

guide.context: Choose a house close to the sea, such as House with a sea view or Stilt house.

steps.text: Buy a seaside HGTV house, for example @loc{House with a sea view} or @loc{Stilt house}.
Go there, press Esc and choose the move office option.

achievements.description: Now, who’s in for a pool party?
achievements.summary: Place an indoor swimming pool inside a room.

guide.context: It does not work outside. Any house will do.

steps.text: Buy an indoor swimming pool.
Place it inside a room of any house.

achievements.description: Replace 10 windows
achievements.summary: Replace 10 windows.

steps.text: Play the second Luxury job, @loc{A new chapter}.
Replace windows with E until you have replaced 10.

achievements.description: One man’s trash is another man’s treasure
achievements.summary: Restore 5 pieces of old furniture.

steps.text: Find old furniture in the Luxury jobs.
Press E on a piece to restore it. Do this 5 times.

achievements.description: All it takes is a good smack with a hammer
achievements.summary: Hit the steering wheel on the boat with your hammer.

guide.context: The boat is for sale only once its job is done.

steps.text: Finish the first Luxury job, @loc{I'm on a boat!}.
Buy the boat.
Climb to the top deck and swing your hammer at the steering wheel.

achievements.description: Take a picture of the city from the Cliff House
achievements.summary: Photograph the city skyline while standing in the garden of the Cliff House.

guide.context: You must stand outside; a photo from indoors does not count.

steps.text: Buy or start the job at the @loc{Cliff House}.
Stand in the garden, near the pool.
Use your tablet to take a photo of the city.

achievements.description: Finish all jobs in Moonrise Bay
achievements.summary: Finish all the Luxury DLC jobs in Moonrise Bay.

guide.context: There are 13 jobs, from I'm on a boat! to Family Values.

steps.text: Finish all 13 Luxury DLC jobs. They do not need to be at 100%.

achievements.description: Purchase one of the houses from Luxury DLC
achievements.summary: Buy a house from the Luxury DLC.

steps.text: Open the laptop and buy any Luxury DLC house.

achievements.description: The next step is to hire a butler
achievements.summary: Move your office to a Luxury DLC house.

steps.text: Buy a Luxury DLC house and go there.
Press Esc and choose the move office option.

achievements.description: If we allowed you to do this, the game would crash
achievements.summary: Try to sell a client choice icon with the sell tool.

steps.text: In a Luxury job with a choice icon, take out the sell tool.
Aim at the choice icon and try to sell it.

achievements.description: Did someone call a stair specialist?
achievements.summary: Change a staircase with the sell tool.

steps.text: Play the second Luxury job, @loc{A new chapter}.
Aim the sell tool at the staircase and change it.

achievements.description: Will you follow your client's dream?
achievements.summary: Make your first client choice in a Luxury job.

steps.text: Play the second Luxury job, @loc{A new chapter}.
Pick a floor type when the choice bubble appears.

achievements.description: Tons of cuteness to say the least!
achievements.summary: Open the box in the first Pets DLC job.

guide.context: The animal in the box can be left unadopted.

steps.text: Start the first Pets DLC job, from @npc{Alice Finbar}.
Open the box and finish the job.

achievements.description: Morgan is proud of you.
achievements.summary: Finish all the Pets DLC jobs.

guide.context: They do not need to be at 100%.

steps.text: Do each job on the Pets DLC map until all are finished.

achievements.description: Hope you enjoy the countryside.
achievements.summary: Move your office to a house in Cozy Village.

steps.text: Buy a Pets DLC house in Cozy Village and go there.
Press Esc and choose the move office option.

achievements.description: Feels like the beginning of something special.
achievements.summary: Adopt a pet from Morgan's pet house.

steps.text: Open the laptop, go to Morgan and adopt any animal.

achievements.description: Now your pup can get all dirty again.
achievements.summary: Wash a dirty pet in a special bath.

guide.context: Pets get dirty over time. Wait until yours is dirty.

steps.text: Buy the big blue washing station and place it.
When your pet is dirty, wash it there.

achievements.description: The best part of the day.
achievements.summary: Play with your pet from the interaction menu.

steps.text: Open your pet's interaction menu and choose the play option.

achievements.description: Can you hear those little paws behind you?
achievements.summary: Tell your pet to follow you.

steps.text: Open your pet's interaction menu and choose follow me, not sit.

achievements.description: You're not gonna stop here, are you?
achievements.summary: Adopt 3 different kinds of animals.

guide.context: One dog, one cat and one rabbit is a combination that worked.

steps.text: On the laptop, adopt one dog, one cat and one rabbit from @npc{Morgan}.

achievements.description: Now, that's not a happy little accident.
achievements.summary: Mop up an animal's mess inside a house.

steps.text: Play the first Pets DLC job.
Mop the animal dirt on the floor. It shows on the mini map.

achievements.description: A helping paw is never a bad thing, eh?
achievements.summary: Bring a pet along to a job.

steps.text: Adopt a pet.
Open its interaction menu and choose to take it with you, then start a job.

achievements.description: It feels like we've met yesterday!
achievements.summary: Let a pet grow from a baby to an adult.

guide.context: It grows as game time passes. Keep playing.

steps.text: Adopt a baby animal.
Keep playing until it is a young animal and then an adult.

achievements.description: It's hard to get a good photo when they move around so quickly.
achievements.summary: Take a photo of your pet with your tablet.

guide.context: The pet moves a lot, so wait for it to stay still.

steps.text: Adopt a pet.
Use your tablet to take a photo of it.

achievements.description: Careful now, it’s obviously a family heirloom!
achievements.summary: Touch the peacock statue in the secret room behind the waterfall.

steps.text: Start the Luxury job @loc{Family Values}.
Walk around the back of the house and drop down next to the waterfall.
Walk through the waterfall into the secret room.
Touch the @item{peacock statue}.

achievements.description: Is there an animal you haven’t got?
achievements.summary: Buy one of each of the 8 farm animals.

guide.context: Buy a hen and a rooster separately. Animals are bought in the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.

collectibles.name: Hen
collectibles.method: Buy it from the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.

collectibles.name: Rooster
collectibles.method: Buy it from the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.

collectibles.name: Cow
collectibles.method: Buy it from the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.

collectibles.name: Horse
collectibles.method: Buy it from the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.

collectibles.name: Pig
collectibles.method: Buy it from the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.

collectibles.name: Sheep
collectibles.method: Buy it from the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.

collectibles.name: Alpaca
collectibles.method: Buy it from the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.

collectibles.name: Goat
collectibles.method: Buy it from the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.

achievements.description: Making photos, watering, spraying… Everything on the fly!
achievements.summary: Take a photo and fertilize crops with the drone.

guide.context: Both actions must be done with the drone. Fertilizing needs the High-tech farmer perks.

steps.text: Play the job @loc{In deep water} to get the drone.
Spend skill points on the High-tech farmer perks.
Fly the drone and take a photo.
Fly the drone over crops and press E to fertilize.

achievements.description: House extensions are just too much fun!
achievements.summary: Build a new building or extension.

guide.context: The tool unlocks after the first Farm job.

steps.text: Finish the first Farm DLC job and go back to your house.
Open the tool menu, go to page 2 and pick House Building.
Left-click, then press E to build.

achievements.description: Your house, your rules, your radio.
achievements.summary: Turn on a radio.

steps.text: Buy the @item{BoomFez radio} on the tablet and place it.
Press E on it to play music.

achievements.description: Hope you're not afraid of heights!
achievements.summary: Grapple up to the treetop.

steps.text: Finish the first Farm DLC job to get the grappling hook.
Aim at the top of a tree and pull yourself up.

achievements.description: Ride like the wind!
achievements.summary: Jump a horse over an obstacle.

steps.text: Buy a horse from the Happy Ranch shop on the laptop.
Buy a @item{Cavaletti Obstacle} on the tablet and place it.
Ride the horse and jump over the obstacle without touching it.

achievements.description: Your efforts have yielded a harvest.
achievements.summary: Plant and harvest each of the 6 crops.

guide.context: Use the hoe to dig soil. Buy seeds on the tablet.

collectibles.name: Tomato
collectibles.method: Dig soil with the hoe, buy seeds on the tablet, plant them, wait, then harvest.

collectibles.name: Sunflower
collectibles.method: Dig soil with the hoe, buy seeds on the tablet, plant them, wait, then harvest.

collectibles.name: Pumpkin
collectibles.method: Dig soil with the hoe, buy seeds on the tablet, plant them, wait, then harvest.

collectibles.name: Potato
collectibles.method: Dig soil with the hoe, buy seeds on the tablet, plant them, wait, then harvest.

collectibles.name: Corn
collectibles.method: Dig soil with the hoe, buy seeds on the tablet, plant them, wait, then harvest.

collectibles.name: Carrot
collectibles.method: Dig soil with the hoe, buy seeds on the tablet, plant them, wait, then harvest.

achievements.description: Still looking for a golden egg?
achievements.summary: Have exactly 20 chicken eggs in your pantry.

guide.context: The count may need to hit exactly 20. If you pass it, sell some eggs and gather again.

steps.text: Buy hens and a nest or chicken coop. Add feeder and water trough.
Collect eggs while the hens sit on their nests.
Check the pantry on your tablet. If it jumps from 19 to 21, drop to 18 and take 2 more.

achievements.description: Fancy an afternoon snack with a Minotaur?
achievements.summary: Reach the center of the corn maze.

guide.context: The drone gives an aerial view of the maze.

steps.text: Start the job @loc{Grandpa's summer surprise}.
Enter the corn maze to the left of the house.
Walk to the table in the center. Use the drone to see the layout.

achievements.displayName: A long day in the countryside
achievements.description: Hard work pays off!
achievements.summary: Finish all 10 Farm DLC jobs.

guide.context: They do not need to be at 100%.

steps.text: Do all 10 jobs on the Farm DLC map.

achievements.description: Show your true colors!
achievements.summary: Change the color of a roof with the sell tool.

steps.text: Play the job @loc{Mae Delicious}.
Climb onto the roof and aim the sell tool at it.
Change the roof color.

achievements.description: Finally, nothing limits your imagination!
achievements.summary: Move your office to an empty farm plot.

steps.text: Buy one of the empty plots, such as @loc{Like a Painting}.
Say yes when asked to move your office, or press Esc and choose the move option.

achievements.description: Finish the first Dine Out job.
achievements.summary: Finish the first Dine Out job.

steps.text: Finish the first Dine Out job, Just like Grandma used to make.

achievements.description: Finish any 5 Dine Out jobs.
achievements.summary: Finish any 5 Dine Out jobs.

steps.text: Finish 5 Dine Out jobs. They do not need to be at 100%.

achievements.description: Finish all 10 Dine Out jobs.
achievements.summary: Finish all 10 Dine Out jobs.

guide.context: They do not need to be at 100%.

steps.text: Finish these 10 jobs: Espresso Tales, Just like Grandma used to make, Wine & Dine, Delicious Nook of tin Pavilions, Rematch is a dish..., Ahoy Gourmands!, Sweet Metamorphosis, Cloud-high Surprise, The new Face of Mastery and Pizzalicious Happiness.

achievements.description: Cook 5 dishes in the universal cooker.
achievements.summary: Cook 5 dishes in the universal cooker.

guide.context: The same dish can be cooked again and again.

steps.text: Buy the universal cooker and add the recipe from the first job.
Queue the dish about 5 times and let it cook.

achievements.displayName: Why live on bread and water?
achievements.description: Earn 50,000 in total rent from houses you rent out, counted in the game's base currency.
achievements.summary: Earn 50,000 in total rent from houses you rent out, counted in the game's base currency.

guide.context: Rent is counted in the game's base currency, so the amount shown in another currency may look lower.

steps.text: Rent out several houses using the Esc menu.
Keep playing so rent keeps coming in. Check back until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Rent out 5 houses.
achievements.summary: Rent out 5 houses.

guide.context: Any of the 4 rental types counts.

steps.text: Buy a house and press Esc.
Pick the sell option, then the rent option.
Repeat until 5 houses are rented.

achievements.description: Fall through an open gap in a floor inside a building.
achievements.summary: Fall through an open gap in a floor inside a building.

steps.text: Start the job @loc{Cloud-high Surprise}.
Walk off the open floor edge and fall to the floor below.

achievements.description: Create 10 tableware presets on dining tables.
achievements.summary: Create 10 tableware presets on dining tables.

steps.text: Buy a dining table and plates, cutlery and similar items, then place them on the table.
Press E on the table and save a tableware preset. Repeat 10 times.

achievements.displayName: Don't judge a restaurant by its sign
achievements.description: Edit a neon sign for a restaurant.
achievements.summary: Edit a neon sign for a restaurant.

steps.text: Play the 5th Dine Out job, @loc{Rematch is a dish...}.
Customize the restaurant's neon sign.

achievements.description: Unlock all 31 recipes for the universal cooker.
achievements.summary: Unlock all 31 recipes for the universal cooker.

guide.context: 20 recipes come from the Master chef perks. 11 are found in the Dine Out jobs. Quick recipes such as dumplings earn skill points fast.

steps.text: Search every Dine Out job for its recipe: Dumplings; Cupcakes and Coffee (Latte Art), which sits in a kitchen cupboard and comes with a second recipe; Spaghetti Bolognese; Ramen, Tacos de Birria, Fish and Chips, Macarons, Ratatouille, Sushi and Pizza Margherita.
Cook quick recipes in the universal cooker to earn skill points fast.
Spend the points on the Master chef perks to unlock the other 20 recipes.
